answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade: the stake is slashed if peers prove the agent duplicated its identity. A new identity starts on a low knoll of trust, earning higher limits only after weeks of attested work, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of stakes and wait out the climb to the zenith of full privileges. Each fake costs real capital and time, while one honest agent pays once.
